_comment: Routes the visual QA agent captures, and the viewports it captures them at.
390px is FIRST and is not decoration: this repo's own conventions say 'the phone
view IS the product', so a regression there matters more than one at 1280.
AUTH: a route with "auth": true sits behind the login wall. A pass-scoped token
is injected only into its document and immutable static-asset request headers by
a private extension; sanitized in-page fixtures answer every dashboard data read.
The token cannot read gate-backed state and is never an operator cookie. Those
routes are only capturable through POST /qa/run, which reserves the lane and mints one.
Direct/manual runner invocation is refused instead of photographing the login wall
and adopting it as a baseline. A baseline of the login page would compare clean
forever and catch nothing, which is worse than having no baseline at all.
The workspace is served ONLY at the canonical root -- /cc, /kanban and the other
standalone paths are retired (HTTP 410) and the room is chosen client-side. So
the authenticated capture is '/' again, and it is a genuinely different page from
the unauthenticated '/' above it: one is the login wall, one is the workspace.
